definitions.scope: all cost_log iterations, grouped by worker and pool
definitions.metric: fraction of each worker busy computing, plus the mean across each pool, in each time bin
definitions.bin: one equal-width time segment (fine view, 200 bins over the run span)
definitions.worker_capacity: bin_width — the denominator for one worker's busy fraction
definitions.pool_capacity: bin_width × workers_in_pool — the denominator for the pool-average fraction
definitions.avg_util: worker busy time / span, or pool busy time / (span × workers_in_pool)
definitions.note: a unified worker runs its replica in lockstep across its GPUs, so worker-busy ≡ GPU-busy and the fraction reads as per-GPU utilization
